repo.name: OpenLumen (MikolajQ fork)
repo.description: Builds of the MikolajQ/OpenLumen fork (branch miq): OpenLumen with a day filter, a Night Light overwrite guard, more transition durations and optional coarse location for the solar schedule. Signed by the fork's own key, so it does not update an OpenLumen installed from elsewhere.

apps.description:
Fork of OpenLumen (https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/OpenLumen) built from the
miq branch. On top of upstream: a lighter filter outside the schedule window,
restoring the SurfaceFlinger filter after the system's Night Light overwrites
it, 1/3 minute and custom transitions, and optional coarse location for the
sunset schedule.
apps.name: OpenLumen (fork)
apps.summary: Screen color filter with a day profile and Night Light guard
